summary: H-014A.1 frontend-only regression after backend security hardening (QC-1 property non-disclosure, QC-3 deterministic 2-frame coordinate set). Logged in as homeowner via demo-homeowner quick button, navigated via left-nav to /reality-foundation and /steward (no hard reload). All required data-testid assertions passed. QC-3 verified from live bootstrap network response: coordinate_frames array contains EXACTLY 2 fixture frames (PROPERTY_FRAME id 'rf-frame-property-h0…', ROOM_FRAME id 'rf-frame-room-h014a…') — no dozens of accumulated dev/test frames. Artifact storage row shows only masked token '<governed-object-store-reference>'; no http/https/fixture://s3://gs:// leak in the storage cell. Read-only confirmed: 0 buttons inside reality-foundation-page. Home Steward regression: /steward loads with Villa Horizon property context, no error banners, body length 1450 chars.
critical_code_review_comments: RealityStudioFoundation.js:107 only extracts the PROPERTY_FRAME and renders a single 'Coordinate frame' panel. The QC-3 fix guarantees exactly 2 frames server-side (PROPERTY_FRAME + ROOM_FRAME), but the UI silently drops the ROOM_FRAME. Consider rendering both frames (or a count chip) so the fix is visually observable to the homeowner and to future testers without inspecting the network tab.

RealityStudioFoundation.js:136 renders `${dims.length} m` from the raw API value (renders '6.1 m' vs the fixture spec's '6.10 m'). Cosmetic — numeric equality holds. Consider Number(dims.length).toFixed(2) for parity with the width label formatting.
seed_data_creation: None; used deterministic dev fixture bootstrapped by POST /reality/v1/development/reference-room/bootstrap.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SPA nav only — do NOT hard-reload URLs (drops in-memory auth). Login: click [data-testid=demo-homeowner]. Reality page: click left-nav text 'Reality Studio (Dev)' → /reality-foundation. Key testids: reality-foundation-page, reality-foundation-fixture-warning, reality-foundation-dim-width ('4.88 m'), reality-foundation-dim-length ('6.1 m' — numeric 6.10), reality-foundation-dimensions panel contains '29.768 m²', reality-foundation-entity-count ('12'), reality-foundation-model-state ('DRAFT_CANDIDATE'), reality-foundation-coordinate-frames panel contains 'PROPERTY_FRAME', reality-foundation-artifact storage row literal '<governed-object-store-reference>'. QC-3 counted 2 frames via network capture of the bootstrap response. Steward regression at /steward via text 'Home Steward AI' — shows Villa Horizon context, no errors.
informational_notes: The full bootstrap JSON payload contains the substring 'fixture://' in an internal field (not the storage_object_reference). The visible UI storage cell correctly renders '<governed-object-store-reference>' with no raw path/URL/scheme. Non-issue for QC-1 UI non-disclosure, but flagged here for completeness.
